verdict.rationale: Event-triggered rules are a fair question for an agentic research platform with an API. The evidence only documents manual or programmatic task submission: create_task, batch run_tasks_until_done, async polling, and injecting chat messages. None of these is a user-defined rule that fires actions automatically on events. Client-side scripting would be a developer building block or user-side workaround, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
